name: BrenWP Client Safe Mode
author: Brendigo Studio

sections.description:
BrenWP Client Safe Mode helps you troubleshoot safely and hand off WordPress sites to clients with fewer risks.

Safe Mode is per-user: it only affects the currently logged-in user who enabled Safe Mode. Visitors and other users are not affected.

Safe Mode can optionally:
* Block access to risky wp-admin screens (plugin/theme management and core updates)
* Disable file modifications (installs, updates, editors)
* Hide update nags
* Trim the admin bar (Updates / Comments / New Content)

Role-based restrictions are intended for client accounts and can:
* Hide risky menus
* Block access to sensitive admin screens
* Disable file modifications
* Hide update nags

Administrators are never restricted by role restrictions.

Privacy

This plugin does not send data to external services.

It stores:
* A per-user flag in user meta (brenwp_csm_safe_mode) to remember whether Safe Mode is enabled for that account.

This data remains on your site. No analytics, tracking, or remote requests are performed by this plugin.

The plugin also:
* Adds suggested text to the Privacy Policy Guide (Settings → Privacy)
* Registers a data exporter and eraser for the Safe Mode user meta
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/brenwp-client-safe-mode/
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Open BrenWP Safe Mode in your wp-admin menu
  4. Configure Safe Mode and Restrictions as needed
sections.faq:
Does Safe Mode affect visitors?

No. Safe Mode is per-user. Visitors and users without Safe Mode enabled see the normal site.

Will administrators be restricted?

Administrators are never restricted by the role-based restrictions. However, if an administrator enables Safe Mode for their own account, optional Safe Mode settings (like blocking file modifications) can apply to that account.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

It stores a per-user Safe Mode flag (user meta) so it can remember your Safe Mode setting. No tracking, analytics, or external requests.

How do I remove all plugin data?

When you uninstall (delete) the plugin, it removes its option, Safe Mode user meta, and the optional bren_client role (best-effort).

  • Hardened escaping and admin messaging for notices.
  • Added optional Safe Mode controls (block screens, file mods, update nags, admin bar trim).
  • Improved multisite compatibility (no Settings link in Network Admin).

1.5.2

  • Removed MU loader functionality.
  • Safe Mode now applies per-user safety restrictions without filtering active plugins.
  • Improved sanitization and admin redirect notice handling.
